market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely range-bound with elevated volatility. Oil-driven energy outperformance offsets property and rate headwinds. Key watch: RBA commentary and any further property credit data. Star Entertainment resolution is a near-term catalyst.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural themes favour strategic minerals, healthcare (GLP-1), and super reform beneficiaries. Property sector faces 12-month adjustment. Political uncertainty from Labor's weakened position may delay pro-growth policy. Iron ore remains the key swing factor for ASX 200 direction.
